name: iam:PassRole + bedrock-agentcore:CreateAgentRuntime + bedrock-agentcore:CreateAgentRuntimeEndpoint + bedrock-agentcore:CreateWorkloadIdentity + bedrock-agentcore:InvokeAgentRuntimeCommand
description: A principal with iam:PassRole, bedrock-agentcore:CreateAgentRuntime, bedrock-agentcore:CreateAgentRuntimeEndpoint, bedrock-agentcore:CreateWorkloadIdentity, and bedrock-agentcore:InvokeAgentRuntimeCommand can deploy a new AgentCore Runtime with a privileged IAM execution role and then run shell commands as root inside its Firecracker microVM. InvokeAgentRuntimeCommand executes a submitted command as root parallel to the customer agent process, bypassing the agent, model and guardrails entirely. The command reads the execution role temporary credentials from the MicroVM Metadata Service (MMDS) at 169.254.169.254, AgentCore's equivalent of EC2's IMDS, granting the attacker the full permissions of the chosen execution role.
author: Seth Art

required.description: Target role ARN must be in Resource; role must trust bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
Must have permission to create Bedrock AgentCore runtimes
Must have permission to create the runtime endpoint used to invoke the runtime
Must have permission to create the workload identity the runtime requires at creation
Must have permission to invoke commands on the created runtime

additional.description: Helpful for discovering AgentCore execution roles available to pass
Useful for viewing role trust policies and attached permissions
Useful for confirming the new runtime reached a READY state before invoking it

admin: A role must exist that trusts bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com to assume it
The role must have administrative permissions (e.g., AdministratorAccess or equivalent)
An attacker-controlled container image must be available in ECR (the runtime pulls it on startup)
lateral: A role must exist that trusts bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com to assume it
An attacker-controlled container image must be available in ECR

references.title: Mapping Every Privilege Escalation Path in AWS AgentCore
Understanding Credentials Management in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore

techniques: T1098.001 - Account Manipulation: Additional Cloud Credentials
T1552.005 - Unsecured Credentials: Cloud Instance Metadata API

options.name: EXECUTION_ROLE_ARN
options.description: ARN of the IAM role to pass to the new runtime as its execution role; must trust bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com

options.name: CONTAINER_URI
options.description: ECR image URI for the runtime (e.g., <account>.dkr.ecr.<region>.amazonaws.com/<repo>:<tag>); the image is always built and pushed by pathrunner — set this to control which ECR repo is used, or leave empty to auto-find/create the attacker ECR repo

options.name: REGION
options.description: AWS region to create the runtime in

options.name: RUNTIME_NAME
options.description: Name for the new AgentCore Runtime (auto-generated if not set)

options.name: PAYLOAD
options.description: Payload to run inside the runtime microVM via InvokeAgentRuntimeCommand (exfil/response or backdoor/attach-policy)

options.name: CLEANUP
options.description: Whether to delete the runtime after credential extraction. Defaults to false because the starting identity typically lacks bedrock-agentcore:DeleteAgentRuntime; use 'workspace cleanup' with the extracted admin identity instead.

payloads.name: backdoor/attach-policy
payloads.description: Attach AdministratorAccess (or custom policy) to an IAM user/role using the execution role's boto3 credentials

payloads.name: exfil/mmds
payloads.description: Extract execution-role credentials from the MicroVM Metadata Service (MMDS) at 169.254.169.254
